name: Sesame Tofu
steps: Drain tofu, wrap in a clean towel and press under a light plate for 15 minutes. Cut into 2 cm cubes; dice capsicum and slice spring onion.
Whisk soy sauce, vinegar, maple syrup, starch and water until smooth.
Heat half the oil in a wide non-stick pan and brown tofu for 8–10 minutes, turning gently. Transfer to a plate.
Add remaining oil, minced garlic, ginger and spring onion whites. Stir for 30 seconds, add capsicum and stir-fry for 3 minutes.
Pour sauce into the pan and stir for 2–3 minutes until glossy; fold in tofu and toasted sesame seeds.
Finish with spring onion greens and taste before adding any extra salt. Serve with separately prepared rice if desired.
tips: Prepare and measure every component before heating the pan; serve promptly for the best texture.
notes: Quantities are for four adult portions. Cooking times are estimates; use the doneness checks in each step. Ingredient costs use sample rates and exclude unpriced items.
